title: Considerations for the Use of Artificial Intelligence to Support Regulatory Decision-Making for Drug and Biological Products
scope: Evidence intended to support regulatory decisions on drug/biological product safety, efficacy or quality; case-specific COU; not general discovery or administrative workflow.

checks.name: Context of use
checks.test: Is model role, scope and supporting evidence documented?

checks.name: Test-data independence
checks.test: Are independent data use and evaluation design described?

checks.name: Model risk
checks.test: Is influence on decision and consequence of error discussed?

checks.name: Prespecified criteria
checks.test: Are context-appropriate prespecified evaluation criteria described?

checks.name: Uncertainty
checks.test: Are confidence intervals or other relevant performance uncertainty presented?

checks.name: Limitations and bias
checks.test: Are relevant limitations, representativeness and bias documented?
